item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena adds salt, a little at a time, to 100 mL of water in a glass, stirring after each addition. Which statement about her experiment is not correct?

options.A: The amount of salt that dissolves increases as more salt is added, at first.
options.B: The solubility of salt is the maximum amount that can dissolve in a fixed quantity of water.
options.C: If Meena keeps stirring long enough, the water can always dissolve more salt.
options.D: After the water has dissolved its maximum amount of salt, extra salt stays undissolved.
